_why: Collapse guard only, not completeness. The sitemap count moves legitimately whenever a stream host dies (2026-09-24: 9,354 to 8,504 on purpose, f62b688), so a floor near the live count cries wolf on correct behaviour. 4,000 is about half of today's 8,504: it catches a broken or partial deploy, and completeness is checked separately as an identity (every page left out of the sitemap must be noindex). Never fit this to yesterday's output.
_allowed_external_why: Both measured in a browser on 2026-09-24 and both chosen: Simple Analytics (Arun asked for it, 2026-09-20) and the Cloudflare Pages beacon (auto-injected at runtime, so it is permitted, not required). Any third host fails. The property that survives is 'no third-party PLAYER bytes before a click', not 'no third party'.
_deploy_max_age_why: Deploys ran every few days in September; 10 days is generous enough that a quiet week does not page. Parsed from deploy-id.txt's own leading UTC timestamp.
